crossRefs.note: So David and all the house of Israel brought up Yahweh’s ark with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet.
David spoke to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brothers as singers with instruments of music, stringed…
David and all Israel played before God with all their might, even with songs, with harps, with stringed instruments…
also the Levites who were the singers, all of them, even Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun, and their sons and their brothers…
when the trumpeters and singers were as one, to make one sound to be heard in praising and thanking Yahweh; and when…
When the builders laid the foundation of Yahweh’s temple, they set the priests in their clothing with trumpets, with…
They sang to one another in praising and giving thanks to Yahweh, “For he is good, for his loving kindness endures…
Oh clap your hands, all you nations. Shout to God with the voice of triumph!
The singers went before, the minstrels followed after, among the ladies playing with tambourines,
Make a joyful noise to Yahweh, all the earth! Burst out and sing for joy, yes, sing praises!
Praise him with the sounding of the trumpet! Praise him with harp and lyre!

parallels.note: So David and all the house of Israel brought up Yahweh’s ark with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet.
God has gone up with a shout, Yahweh with the sound of a trumpet.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Thus all Israel brought the ark of Yahweh’s covenant up with shouting, with sound of the cornet, with trumpets, and with cymbals, sounding aloud with stringed instruments and harps.
translations.bsb: So all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the LORD with shouting, with the sounding of rams’ horns and trumpets, and with cymbals and the music of harps and lyres.
translations.kjv: Thus all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the LORD with shouting, and with sound of the cornet, and with trumpets, and with cymbals, making a noise with psalteries and harps.
translations.asv: Thus all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of Jehovah with shouting, and with sound of the cornet, and with trumpets, and with cymbals, sounding aloud with psalteries and harps.
